Container.Name: ironsbot
Container.Overview: EN: IronsBot supports OneBot v11/NapCat and Tencent QQ Official Bot. A complete official AppID and Secret automatically makes QQ Official the only outbound platform; NapCat then stays silent and may only observe identity verification events. ZH: IronsBot 支持 OneBot v11/NapCat 与腾讯 QQ 官方机器人。完整的官方 AppID 和 Secret 会自动使 QQ 官方成为唯一出站平台；NapCat 随即静默，只可用于身份验证事件观察。
Container.Description: EN: Create /config/ironsbot.toml from the current config.example.toml before startup. IronsBot rejects unknown fields. QQ Official custom keyboards remain disabled unless Tencent grants the invite-only capability. Account required/optional policy and READY timeout also belong in TOML, not environment variables. For each account declared as a query worker or lucky-window account, add a masked SEER_PASSWORD_ followed by its player ID environment variable in Unraid and enter the plain-text password; IronsBot derives the login MD5 in memory. Runtime data is stored in /app/data and file logs can be stored in /app/logs. Mount the Docker socket for image checks, self-update, or optional private extension package pulls. ZH: 启动前请根据当前 config.example.toml 创建 /config/ironsbot.toml。IronsBot 会拒绝未知字段。QQ 官方自定义按钮默认关闭，只有腾讯后台开通内邀能力后才可启用。账号是否为必需资源及 READY 超时也写入 TOML，不使用环境变量。对每个在 TOML 中声明为无头查询或幸运橱窗账号的米米号，请在 Unraid 中添加名为 SEER_PASSWORD_加该米米号的加密环境变量，并填写明文密码；IronsBot 只在内存中转换为登录 MD5。运行数据保存在 /app/data，文件日志可保存在 /app/logs。镜像检查、容器自更新或拉取可选私有扩展包时需要挂载 Docker socket。
Container.Requires: EN: OneBot mode requires a client such as NapCat; point its reverse WebSocket to ws://UNRAID_SERVER_IP:8085/onebot/v11/ws, or ws://ironsbot:8080/onebot/v11/ws on a shared Docker network. Published IronsBot images already include the QQ Official runtime; for each enabled official account, add masked AppID and AppSecret environment variables. Pre-create /config/ironsbot.toml and mount /app/data and /app/logs. ZH: OneBot 模式需要 NapCat 等客户端，反向 WebSocket 可填写 ws://UNRAID_SERVER_IP:8085/onebot/v11/ws；共用 Docker 网络时可填写 ws://ironsbot:8080/onebot/v11/ws。正式 IronsBot 镜像已包含 QQ 官方运行组件；请为每个启用的官方账号填写加密的 AppID 和 AppSecret 环境变量。请预先创建 /config/ironsbot.toml，并挂载 /app/data 和 /app/logs。
Container.Changes: Current deployment contract / 当前部署约定: - EN: All behavior and runtime settings, including superusers, listen address, command prefixes, and logging, live in /config/ironsbot.toml. - ZH: 所有行为与运行设置，包括超级管理员、监听地址、命令前缀和日志，统一写在 /config/ironsbot.toml。 - EN: Environment variables contain APP_CONFIG_PATH, deployment credentials, and optional OneBot deployment overrides. - ZH: 环境变量包含 APP_CONFIG_PATH、部署凭据和可选的 OneBot 部署覆盖项。 - EN: Follow config.example.toml for the current configuration fields. - ZH: 请以 config.example.toml 为准填写当前配置字段。

Config.Name: Host WebSocket Port
Config.Description: EN: Host port mapped to the fixed container port 8080. Point the OneBot reverse WebSocket to this host port. ZH: WebSocket 主机端口，映射到固定的容器内 8080；OneBot 反向 WebSocket 连接此主机端口。

Config.Name: IronsBot Data
Config.Description: EN: Persistent runtime data, including caches, cookies, and SQLite databases. ZH: 持久化运行数据目录，用于保存缓存、Cookie 和 SQLite 数据库。

Config.Name: IronsBot Logs
Config.Description: EN: Persistent file logs. Configure filenames under paths in TOML. ZH: 持久化日志目录，文件名在 TOML 的 paths 中配置。

Config.Name: IronsBot Config
Config.Description: EN: Directory containing the pre-created ironsbot.toml. IronsBot never generates or repairs it. ZH: 存放预先创建的 ironsbot.toml；程序不会自动生成或修复该文件。

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: EN: Optional. Enables image checks, container restart/update, and private extension package pulls. This grants control over the host Docker engine. ZH: 可选。用于通过 Docker API 或 Watchtower 检查镜像、重启或更新容器，也用于拉取私有扩展包；挂载后容器可控制宿主机 Docker。

Config.Name: IronsBot Config Path
Config.Description: EN: Required path to the strict TOML config. ZH: 必填，严格 TOML 配置文件路径。

Config.Name: OneBot Access Token
Config.Description: EN: Required for OneBot/NapCat mode and unused by QQ Official-only mode; it must match NapCat. ZH: OneBot/NapCat 模式必填，仅使用 QQ 官方模式时不使用；必须与 NapCat 一致。

Config.Name: OneBot Enabled
Config.Description: EN: Process NapCat events. QQ Official credentials still force NapCat into silent mode. ZH: 是否处理 NapCat 事件；存在 QQ 官方凭据时 NapCat 仍会被强制静默。

Config.Name: OneBot Send Messages
Config.Description: EN: Allow NapCat outbound messages only when no QQ Official credentials exist. ZH: 仅在不存在 QQ 官方凭据时允许 NapCat 发送消息。

Config.Name: OneBot Identity Verification
Config.Description: EN: Let silent NapCat read the source-message sender referenced by trusted official bot replies. Requires complete official credentials and a trusted bot QQ below. ZH: 让静默 NapCat 读取可信官方机器人回复所引用的原消息发送者，用于群身份关联；需要完整官方凭据和下方的可信机器人 QQ。

Config.Name: Trusted Official Bot QQ (EXAMPLE_BOT)
Config.Description: EN: Numeric QQ of this official bot as seen by NapCat. Rename EXAMPLE_BOT to match the TOML account alias. ZH: NapCat 中看到的该官方机器人数字 QQ；需将 EXAMPLE_BOT 改为 TOML 账号别名。

Config.Name: QQ Official AppID (EXAMPLE_BOT)
Config.Description: EN: Optional masked AppID for [bot.qq_official.accounts.example_bot]. Rename EXAMPLE_BOT in the key when using another account alias. ZH: 可选，[bot.qq_official.accounts.example_bot] 的加密 AppID；使用其他账号别名时需同步修改变量名中的 EXAMPLE_BOT。

Config.Name: QQ Official AppSecret (EXAMPLE_BOT)
Config.Description: EN: Optional masked AppSecret for [bot.qq_official.accounts.example_bot]. Rename EXAMPLE_BOT in the key when using another account alias. ZH: 可选，[bot.qq_official.accounts.example_bot] 的加密 AppSecret；使用其他账号别名时需同步修改变量名中的 EXAMPLE_BOT。

Config.Name: AI Chat API Key
Config.Description: EN: Optional OpenAI-compatible API key. ZH: 可选，OpenAI 兼容 AI 接口密钥。

Config.Name: SendPic CNB Token
Config.Description: EN: Optional CNB token for configured SendPic repositories. ZH: 可选，SendPic 使用 CNB 仓库时的访问令牌。

Config.Name: GitHub Workflow Token
Config.Description: EN: Optional token for operations.data_sync remote builds. ZH: 可选，operations.data_sync 远程构建使用的 GitHub Token。

Config.Name: Docker Registry Username
Config.Description: EN: Optional Docker Hub username for private extension package pulls or private image updates. ZH: 可选。用于拉取私有扩展包或更新私有镜像的 Docker Hub 用户名。

Config.Name: Docker Registry Token
Config.Description: EN: Optional pull-only Docker Hub token for private extension packages or private image updates; never write it in TOML. ZH: 可选。私有扩展包或私有镜像更新使用的 Docker Hub 只读拉取令牌；不要写入 TOML。
